## What changed

- `kmctl summary ack` no longer rewrites the `checked` block in
  `.okf/summary.md`. It writes a new file under `.okf/.acks/`, with a name
  no other ack has, so two branches that both ack merge without a
  conflict (#62).
- The summary is reported as behind when a concept change is not in the
  history of any commit that edited the summary or added an ack. A merge
  commit does not count. After a merge, an edit that one branch made
  after its own ack is now listed (#62).
- `kmctl check` fails when two decision records start with the same
  number, and names the next free number to give one of them with
  `kmctl mv` (#63).

## Before you upgrade

- Run `kmctl check` after the upgrade. A bundle that already has two
  decision records with one number fails until one is renamed with
  `kmctl mv`.
- Each branch that an older kmctl acked still changes the `checked`
  block. The first ack by v0.15.0 deletes the block, so git reports a
  conflict in the summary one last time. Keep the side without the block.

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.15.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.15.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0
